title: Kairos: A Dataset for Fine-Grained Video-Language Modeling over Space, Time, and Dynamics

body: Many emerging video language modeling tasks require systems to move beyond clip-level abstraction and model visual content as it unfolds over extended time horizons. However, most existing video datasets rely on coarse or sparsely aligned supervision, which compresses temporal variation and limits the ability of models to learn reusable representations of continuous visual dynamics. We introduce Kairos, a video dataset for video-language modeling with time-resolved annotations. Kairos consists of long-duration videos, ranging from ten minutes to half an hour, annotated with fine-grained temporal alignment. The annotations capture ongoing actions, entity appearances and attributes, interactions, and evolving contextual cues along the video timeline. This time-resolved structure supports fine-grained evaluation, long-range modeling and reasoning, instruction data construction, representation learning, and video generation. Kairos provides a general-purpose foundation for modeling visual experiences over time.
summaryZh: 该研究介绍了Kairos，一个用于视频-语言建模的数据集，其特点是包含长时间视频（10分钟至半小时）和细粒度的时间分辨率标注。这些标注涵盖了动作、实体属性、交互和上下文线索等，支持对视频内容进行时间序列上的精细建模和推理。Kairos旨在解决现有视频数据集监督粒度粗糙的问题，促进模型学习可复用的连续视觉动态表示。该数据集可用于细粒度评估、长程建模与推理、指令数据构建、表示学习和视频生成等多种任务，为视频语言建模提供了一个通用的基础。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该研究提出了一个名为Kairos的数据集，用于细粒度的视频-语言建模，虽然提到了视频-语言建模，但其核心是数据集的发布而非LLM技术的具体应用或进展，且未提供模型发布或广泛采用的证据。
